description: Analogue bass drum voice with a pitch envelope, a drive stage with three circuits, and a choke input

params.text: Sets how long the drum rings on after a trigger
Sets the cutoff of the low-pass filter on the drum
Sets the pitch of the drum
Sets how much louder a hit is when a gate is present at the accent input as the drum is triggered
Attenuates the voltage at the FM input before it changes the drum pitch
Sets how far the pitch envelope bends the drum pitch away from the tuned pitch
Sets how quickly the pitch envelope falls back to the tuned pitch
Sets the output level of the drum
Attenuates the voltage at the decay MOD input before it lengthens or shortens the decay
Selects which of three drive circuits shapes the drum, the positions printed as a red, an orange and a yellow lamp
Sets the amount of drive applied to the drum
Sets how quickly the drive envelope falls
Sets how much the drive envelope adds to or takes away from the drive, -1 to +1

inputs.text: A rising edge to 1V or more fires the drum
A gate of 1V or more here at the moment of a trigger makes that hit louder, by the amount set by the ACCENT knob
Voltage control of the drum pitch, scaled by the FM knob
Voltage control of the decay, scaled by a fifth and then by the decay MOD knob
Voltage control of the pitch envelope decay: 0V leaves it as set, 1V doubles it and -1V collapses it to nothing
A gate of 1V or more here cuts the drum short

outputs.text: The drum, as a single audio signal

notes: no sound comes out of OUT until a trigger arrives at TRIG; the knobs shape a hit and none of them sounds on its own
menu: Model 2 — switches the voice to the second bass drum model
